scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='pub/static'; const dest='public/static'; fs.rmSync(dest,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});" && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/input.css -o ./public/static/css/output.css --minify && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
